Aside from the operational duties, you also make sure our people feel genuinely at home in the office.

If you're an organizational talent who thrives on taking ownership, enjoys variety, and stays composed when priorities shift unexpectedly, this role is for you!

This is a** full-time**, Berlin-based position with an immediate start.

Your mission

- Own and optimize office operations, including procurement processes, supplier management, and inventory control

- Stay flexible and adaptable as priorities shift, adjusting plans and approaches as the business needs evolve

Job requirements

What You Bring

- At least two years of experience in office management or a related field, ideally with a background in hospitality or event management
- Excellent written and spoken German (minimum C1 level) and English; additional European languages are a plus
- Strong organizational skills paired with a structured, reliable, and solution-oriented way of working

jobs.occupation: Senior Software Engineer – Flash (f/m/d) (Softwareentwickler/in)
jobs.description:
About Us

What if your work could drive change in a globally established industry, shaping processes that touch every corner of the world? At Forto, we are at the forefront of change, harnessing the power of AI to revolutionise logistics. We want to reinvent digital supply chains to be transparent, frictionless and sustainable. From day one, our mission has been to simplify global trade – creating a seamless and efficient logistics process.

Your Role & Mission

The mission of the Flash team at Forto is to fundamentally redesign operations processes by leveraging automation and intelligent decision-making to handle shipments more efficiently. We aim to scale CoPilot so that it becomes the primary system used by operations managers, enabling them to be more effective and efficient in their daily work.

As a Senior Software Engineer in the Flash team, you will help build AI-driven solutions and the CoPilot that powers our logistics operations. You will maintain and evolve a sophisticated event-driven, distributed architecture designed to answer one key question:

How do we improve shipment handling and bring efficiency to our operations teams at scale?

From quotation and rate management, to shipment execution and schedule optimization (capacity utilization and GP optimization), to carrier integrations and automated data extraction from unstructured sources (emails, PDFs, spreadsheets), this role focuses on building reliable, data-heavy systems that directly impact revenue and operational performance.

What you will do

- Design, build, and evolve scalable and resilient backend systems
- Contribute to an event-driven, distributed architecture
- Work on AI-adjacent systems (integration, orchestration, data-heavy workflows)
- Own services end-to-end (design, implementation, documentation, operation)
- Collaborate closely with product managers, operations, and other engineers
- Communicate clearly with stakeholders and explain technical trade-offs
- Contribute to technical standards and best practices within the team
- Foster a culture of excellence by coaching team members in best practices for backend engineering, domain-driven design, and navigating the complexities of the logistics domain.

Required Skills and Experience

- Strong grasp of data structures, algorithms, and complexity analysis, particularly as they apply to large-scale data processing and financial calculations.
- Proven professional software craftsmanship, with a focus on building high-quality, maintainable, and testable code (an understanding of TDD is a plus).
- Expertise in designing and implementing large-scale, event-driven microservices architectures and robust APIs, with a keen understanding of data consistency in distributed systems.
- Deep understanding of synchronous vs. asynchronous communication patterns and their impact on system performance and reliability
- Hands-on experience developing distributed backend applications, with a strong focus on data consistency, system quality, low latency, and high availability.
- Proficiency in microservices, with hands-on experience in backend technologies such as Node.js, TypeScript, and MongoDB.
- Familiarity with Kubernetes and container orchestration for deploying and managing scalable pricing services.
- Experience with cloud providers (AWS or GCP preferred) for deploying and managing highly available and scalable applications.
- A collaborative, team-oriented mindset with strong critical product thinking and a sense of ownership over the accuracy and effectiveness of pricing data.
- Fluent in English, both verbal and written, for effective communication within a global team.

Preferred Skills and Experience

- Experience integrating AI/LLM-powered features into user faced applications
- Experience applying Domain-Driven Design (DDD) in complex product domains

Don’t fit all of our criteria? That’s okay! We know that you might be hesitant to apply if you don’t meet all our requirements, but here at Forto, we pride ourselves on embracing diverse perspectives and celebrating potential. If you are passionate about this position and the Forto values, please apply anyway. There could be a place for you in this role – or another one that’s a perfect fit! 

Why work with us?

Our team is hard-working, constantly seeking to maximise the impact of their work, but we put our people first, always winning with care. We value efficient systems and swift, direct communication. We want everyone to have their time to speak, so that we can embrace diverse perspectives to help drive towards solutions always.

Senior Industrialization Engineer – Space Manufacturing (all genders)
Garching, Taufkirchen / Full-time / Permanent employee YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

THE WHY

To end COPV failure in spaceflight.

Blackwave manufactures carbon structural components for rockets, and satellites – with the ambition to make space access as reliable and scalable as automotive production. THE WHAT

Be the process mastermind of our manufacturing operation.

At Blackwave, you coordinate production engineering across all teams, set priorities on open issues, and drive our manufacturing processes toward serial production standards – scalable, resilient, and ready for every ramp-up.

Drive & Improve Processes

Systematically analyze production processes for scalability and robustness – then actively raise the bar.

Own and maintain a structured, always-current list of open points across all production steps.

Set the Standards

Implement 5S standards at workstations and in material handling – consistently and sustainably.

Push fixture and tooling improvements from concept through manufacturing, implementation, and verification.

Machine Performance

jobs.occupation: Masses, Loads and Vibration Engineer (all genders) (Ingenieur/in - Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik)
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLEWe are looking for an experienced Masses, Loadsand Vibration Engineer to join our young and growing flight physics team. In this role, you will act as the interface between the flight physics andstructure teams: you will provide the mass estimations, derive the critical load cases from all relevant flight conditions, and quantify and mitigate vibrations for an unmanned, hybrid-electric VTOL transition aircraft. You will be responsible for the mass model, the design load envelopes and the vibration environment from early design through test verification, and your results directly shape structural sizing, performance predictions and the certification evidence of our aircraft. Working close to the hardware is part of the job - ground vibration tests, load testing and flight test verification rely on your hands-on involvement from planning through evaluation.
WHAT YOU WILL DO
• Develop and maintain a mass modelfor all aircraft parts and equipment, including derivation of the weight & balance envelope
• Define, verify and document design load envelopes (flight, ground, gust, maneuvers, landing and payload),traceable to certification bases
• Release critical load cases to a configuration-controlled database that serves as input to the structure team
• Quantify vibration sources and their propagation through structural parts, and design and test mitigation means
• Analyze and demonstrate aeroelastic stability (flutter, whirl flutter, divergence) across the envelope
• Maintain structural elastic models(stiffness and modal representations) and provide them to simulation and control design
• Plan, conduct and evaluate verification campaigns: interface load testing, ground vibration tests and flight test points

WHAT YOU BRING
• You hold an academic degree in Aerospace or Mechanical Engineering or a comparable technical course of study
• Five or more years of professional experience in loads analysis, structural dynamics or mass properties in aerospace round out your background
• Working with loads and dynamics toolchains, preferably Python, is something you're comfortable with
• A sound understanding of loads and vibration requirements in a certification context is part of your expertise
• Target-oriented self-management comes naturally to you, along with the ability to work both within a team and autonomously.
• Strong problem-solving, communication, and technical writing skills complete your profile.
• Fluent English rounds out your qualifications

The following would further strengthen your application:
• Rotorcraft or eVTOL experience, particularly with rotor-induced vibration, is a plus
• Hands-on involvement in ground vibration testing or flight test campaigns adds to your profile
• Experience with aeroelastic stability analysis, such as flutter or whirl flutter, is a valuable asset
• Familiarity with FE-based structural dynamics tools, such as Nastran, strengthens your application
• Mass properties management according to industry practice is an area you bring experience in

WHAT WE OFFER
• Full-scale aerospace engineering, not concept slides
• A 60+ engineer team at Ottobrunn
• Real ownership and flat hierarchies: a modern startup culture where your input shapes decisions, not just execution
• Flexible working hours, remote work, and competitive compensation
• Health & wellbeing: EGYM Wellpass membership and subsidized lunch in our canteen
• Office extras: espresso coffee, fresh fruit, and soft drinks, plus regular team and company events, and plenty more once you're on board

ABOUT THE ROLEWe are looking for a passionate Flight Control Automation Engineer to join our young and growing team. In this role, you will focus on the design and development of robust and reliable flight control automation algorithms. Your contributions will directly impact the performance, safety, and efficiency of our cutting-edge aviation platform. You will play a key role in defining and implementing software for management of different flight control modes in all flight phases of a VTOL transition aircraft. You will also be supporting development of toolchains for classical linear stability and robustness verification of the Flight Control algorithms. Additionally, you will ensure compliance with industry standards, including DO-178C and DO-331, throughout the design lifecycle.
WHAT YOU WILL DO
• Design and implement mode management logic governing switching and reconfiguration between multiple flight control laws
• Define, develop, and implement transition flight-phase procedures, including control mode logic, effector automation strategies, and pilot inceptor interpretation
• Develop and validate algorithms for waypoint-based trajectory generation and guidance laws
• Support the development of automated toolchains for stability, robustness, and performance verification of flight control laws

• Maintain detailed documentation of design activities and their results, including operating procedures for design toolchains, and any identified issues. Contribute to the creation of comprehensive technical documentation

• Have a clear understanding of safety-critical development processes based on DO-178C
• Have experience with model-based software development using MATLAB/Simulink
